messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service inference-ingest-prod at 2026-03-15T12:28:09Z — Severity: P1 — Symptoms: sustained 5xx spike (>10%) across aggregator pods — Paging: ops-oncall
PagerDuty: Alert routed to service inference-frontend (service id: svc-frontend-prod) — oncall: frontend-rotation (matthew) — incident created
Alice Tran: saw the PD page, not on inference rota. who got paged?
Ben Ortiz: that's wrong — inference-frontend != inference-ingest. alert rule probably points to the wrong service id.
Carmen Lee: confirming. alert rule id 0x9f3a is configured with a tag lookup that returned svc-frontend-prod. last change to rule was the refactor on 2026-03-10.
Dave K: PD shows ack by frontend oncall (matthew) and they couldn't find owners for this metric. matthew, can you confirm what you saw?
Matthew: yup, I acked to investigate, tried to mute but couldn't find a matching owner, the metric name matched our "inference" tag so PD assigned to us.
Alice Tran: @matthew thanks. can you reassign or escalate to ops-oncall? if policy blocks we can reroute in PD.
Matthew: tried reassign but governance blocked it (auto-escalation policy). leaving note and unacking so ops can pick it up if they want.
Ben Ortiz: short mitigation: we can silence svc-frontend-prod for 30m: `pd-cli silence create --service svc-frontend-prod --duration 30m --reason "misrouted alert"` but need perms.
Carmen Lee: i'm running a temporary reroute so new matches go to inference-ingest-prod: `pd escalation-rule update --service svc-frontend-prod --auto_escalate_to ops-oncall` — will push a comment to the incident too.
incident-bot: System note: `pd-cli` command executed by carmen_lee at 2026-03-15T12:33:40Z
Carmen Lee: done, reroute applied. also left a playbook entry in the PD incident: "rerouted to inference-ingest-prod; investigate rule config"
Alice Tran: i'll fix the monitoring rule to reference the explicit service id to avoid tag collisions. doing a quick change: 
```
# replace target service id on alert rule
monitoringctl set-target --rule 0x9f3a --service svc-ingest-prod
```
Ben Ortiz: `monitoringctl` returns success, rule now points to svc-ingest-prod. re-evaluating alerts.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert re-evaluated; new incidents created on service inference-ingest-prod (svc-ingest-prod) — oncall: inference-sre rotation
incident-bot: Previous incidents on svc-frontend-prod have been auto-resolved due to silencing / reroute
Dave K: inference-sre — i'm switching my context to oncall-inference and taking ownership. @alice you good to lead mitigation?
Alice Tran: taking it. early triage: spike in 5xx from ingest aggregator between 12:27–12:34 UTC. looks like retry storm from an upstream change amplified error surface.
Ben Ortiz: logs: ingress 5xx count jumped 90 -> 1120 in rolling 1m window. peak at 12:29. affected approx 220 tenants by our tenant-aggregation.
Alice Tran: customer impact: elevated latency and failed ingests for some tenants. no confirmed data loss, ingestion retries succeeded eventually but with higher latency (median +700ms). communicating to customer-facing channels.
Carmen Lee: root cause hypothesis: alert-rule refactor replaced explicit svc id with tag lookup; tag matched multiple services (frontend and ingest). monitoring rule generation script did naive first-match lookup.
Dave K: mitigation steps executed: reroute alerts, silence frontend, monitoring rule fixed. running health checks on ingestion.
Alice Tran: health checks green (ingest success rate back to baseline). I'll file a follow-up: add explicit service_id requirement for production alert rules, and add CI validation to prevent ambiguous tag-only lookups.
Carmen Lee: i'll own the CI validation task. will add a test in monitoring-rule CI: fail if tag-only lookup returns >1 service.
Matthew: sorry for the noise — we acked and tried to help. glad it ended up with inference team. :thumbsup: 
Alice Tran: final actions: PR -> monitoring repo (#1227) with fix, CI validation ticket created (MON-452), runbook updated to mention tag collisions. also created a short PD silence for svc-frontend-prod to avoid duplicate pages: `pd-cli silence create --service svc-frontend-prod --duration 10m --reason "misrouted alert"`
Ben Ortiz: verified metrics returned to baseline by 12:40 UTC.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident on inference-ingest-prod acknowledged by alice_tran at 2026-03-15T12:35:10Z
incident-bot: Incident resolved in PagerDuty at 2026-03-15T12:41:05Z — auto-resolve after no active alerts
Alice Tran: filing a short incident report and tagging the monitoring and infra teams. closing thread unless anyone has follow-ups.
Dave K: nothing else from me, thanks everyone.
Ben Ortiz: closing.
